parts.text:
Each day at the gym, Sarah completes three runs. The distances, in metres, that she completes in the three runs have the independent distributions $W \sim \text{N}(1520, 450)$, $X \sim \text{N}(2250, 720)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(3860, 1050)$.

Find the probability that, on a particular day, $Y$ is less than the total of $W$ and $X$.
